findings.msg: "placeholder" is a placeholder left on the page
findings.fix: write the real words: take the name or figure from the brief, or remove the claim; no bracketed placeholder ships

findings.msg: the closing section is only text: no picture, icon, mock or effect in it
findings.fix: give the section a visual: a photograph that fits, the real icons, or a UI fragment on a ground

findings.msg: the hero has no button (the nav's does not count)
findings.fix: add the action: a button in the hero, one on every priced item, one in the closing section

findings.msg: "Termos de uso" does not name what is sold (softwares de gestao e esportivos para clubes, parques e pequenas e medias empresas, softwares, gestao, from flags)
findings.fix: put the category noun in the h1 (and who it is for, or where), in 2 to 8 words

findings.msg: "Situação deste texto" names no product, part, place or section (the one brand line a page may have)
findings.fix: name the thing in every heading: the product, a part, the place or a section noun

findings.msg: "Contato" does not start with a verb (book, buy, try, start, get, see...)
findings.fix: label buttons with a verb and what the visitor gets ("Book a room", "Start free trial")

findings.msg: 1 library source (placehold): the page credits placehold; confirm each shows the client's own product, place or people
findings.fix: confirm the library photograph shows the client's own product, place or people; otherwise replace it

findings.msg: the page; 90 words a screen across the page (90 words in 1 screens): a tech page says it in about 80 or fewer
findings.fix: cut every section to its heading, one line and the product UI: the UI says the rest; no second paragraph, no list of feature sentences

findings.msg: a software page (--type) deals no moment: every kind carries one, two on a long page (moments.md)
findings.fix: deal one (moments.mjs pick --page software) and mount it in its own section

findings.msg: 39% of the section is empty: 40% beside content that covers under half the container, in its 614px of rows (WARN over 35%, FAIL over 50%)
findings.fix: fill the section: a picture or a second column beside the words, or more of its own content; the section stays one or two screens tall (T-height)

findings.msg: the first Tab stop is "Pular para o conteúdo", not a skip link: a keyboard user tabs through the whole nav on every visit
findings.fix: add the starter's skip link as the header's first child: Skip to content

findings.msg: the head lacks theme-color: a shared link shows no picture or title of its own
findings.fix: copy the head block of starter.html: og tags, twitter:card, the icon and theme-color (references/system.md, Head)
